nodes.title: Motor to mount: 4 x M3x8 into the motor base
nodes.equation: P = T/(K d); head bearing = P / (pi/4 (dh^2 - dhole^2)); screw tension F_t = ff (F/4 + M/s_min); separation RF = P / F_t; thread strip = 0.5 pi d Le tau_Al

nodes.title: Motor-mount slit collar: M3x16 + nyloc, rocking under the prop-nut torque
nodes.equation: protrusion = L - (2 ear + slit + nw wt); needed nyloc h + n p; clamp N = Ts/(mu pi r), bolt torque = K N d; rocking bearing p = 6 M/(od grip^2), M = Tprop sf ff pf; tube hoop = p r / t

nodes.title: FC on M3 heat-set inserts: engagement and pull-out
nodes.equation: engagement = L - stack >= kmin d; blind hole >= engagement + 0.5 mm; RF = pull-out / (F ff pf), whole avionics crash load on one insert

nodes.title: Tube-in-block, block-on-spar and station-collar bonds in torsion
nodes.equation: tau = T / (2 pi r^2 L), T = T_ult ff pf; spar OD = tube OD (22 mm); tube bore L = core + 2 bosses; L_req = T / (2 pi r^2 tau)

nodes.title: Edge-strip anchorage in the station collar and strip-to-board shear flow
nodes.equation: F = sigma_ult w t ff pf, sigma_ult = sigma_allow/(1+MS_edge); anchor tau = F/(n w L); L_req = F/(2 w tau); shear flow q = F/L_strip onto the paper face, tau = q/w vs kd tau_board; pins: P = q pitch, shear P/(pi d^2/4), bending 32 P (tb+t)/2 / (pi d^3)

nodes.title: Brace ends in their slots and the anchor on the spar
nodes.equation: end bond tau = F pf / (2 (w+t) e); anchor pull-off sigma = F pf / (ax ay), whole brace force normal

nodes.title: Bonds into XPS and onto paper-faced board at the C6 allowables
nodes.equation: foot shoe RF = SF_D5 kd (D5 used the undiscounted 0.20 MPa); fin root RF = RF_D3 kd; pod: sigma = F ff pf / A + 6 M ff pf / (b Leff^2), Leff = A/b, vs kd sigma_XPS

nodes.title: Servo frame and control horn: minimum bond area into XPS
nodes.equation: F = Mh/arm (V_D/V_B2)^2 sf ff pf; A_min = F / (kd sigma_XPS)

nodes.title: Foot piston snap hook: minimum finger length
nodes.equation: cantilever snap fit eps = 1.5 t y / L^2  ->  L_min = sqrt(1.5 t y / eps)

nodes.title: Epoxy lap shear on abraded PETG and CF
nodes.procedure: 5 single-lap coupons each: PETG-PETG and PETG-CF tube offcut, 25 x 12.5 mm overlap, 120 grit + IPA, 30 min epoxy, 24 h cure; hang water jugs on a luggage scale to failure. Allowable = mean x 0.5; pass >= 2.0 MPa (ASM-C4-BOND-SHEAR)

nodes.title: Epoxy on paper-faced foam board
nodes.procedure: 5 PETG tabs 20 x 20 mm bonded on a scuffed board face, pull in shear to failure; record the failure mode (paper peels vs epoxy). Allowable = 0.5 x mean (replaces ASM-D5-BOND-TAU x KD)

nodes.title: Flatwise pull of an epoxy puck on XPS
nodes.procedure: 5 printed pucks 30 mm dia bonded with microballoon epoxy on hot-wire-cut F-250 offcut, pull normal to the face; allowable = 0.5 x mean (replaces ASM-D3-XPS-TENSILE x KD)

nodes.title: Heat-set insert pull-out
nodes.procedure: 3 inserts in a printed boss (same settings as POD-002), M3 screw + washer, pull to failure; pass >= 300 N each

nodes.title: Motor screw creep on a hot printed plate
nodes.procedure: Printed mount plate (final material) on an aluminium block with 4 x M3x8 at 0.20 N m, 2 h at 70 degC (oven), cool, breakaway torque >= 0.15 N m on all four

nodes.title: Edge-strip pull-out from the collar tail
nodes.procedure: Print the station collar tail alone; bond a 10 x 1 strip in it as built; pull along the strip with water jugs; pass >= 1 350 N (design force)

nodes.title: Prop-nut torque on a finished mount
nodes.procedure: Bell held by hand, prop nut to 1.5 N m and off 10 times; collar witness line and lip cap unmoved
